_note: Byte ceilings. reference_max_bytes and corpus_max_bytes are tripwires, not caps: they do not forbid growth, they force it to stop and be accounted for here before it lands. Raise either only together with a line in _history saying what the growth bought. Lower them whenever reduction lands.

Content growth, from a defect the method found in itself: ja-JP 78233, en-US 78261 (+185 / +152). Item 12 now audits the list item by item and requires an unhonoured item to be reported as unhonoured.

Content growth, deliberate: ja-JP 78233 -> 79196, en-US 78261 -> 79156 (+963 / +895). Bought two things the text carried procedurally but never told anyone to reach for. Layering orthogonal frameworks was written entirely as risk, and a second framework was gated as an exception admitted only when the first could not handle an information type; it now names the intersections of two grids as a source of structure no single framework yields, with orthogonality kept as the condition rather than the gate. The temporal and transition models sat as two uses among four with no reason to prefer them; they now say what placement cannot show. The transition procedure gained a fifth step keeping each factor trajectory separate, because collapsing the factors averages away that different ones took different routes at different times. Paid for in part by removing the instruction to open without framework names when the audience interest is unknown (-81 / -59), which withheld the value source before it had been tried. Largest reference 14380 -> 14857 (ja-JP).
